view: Frontal chest radiograph, likely PA erect (scapulae mostly rotated off the lung fields); adequate inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation, trachea midline
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration and no significant rotation; lower thorax and upper abdomen appear relatively under-penetrated/bright so the retrocardiac and subdiaphragmatic regions are less well assessed. Top right image corner has a black redaction bar. Patient's upper arms/soft tissue partly project along both lateral image edges (more on the patient's left).

devices.type: External metallic circular marker (side/skin marker or clothing fastener) with small hook-shaped component above it
devices.location: Projecting over the patient's left shoulder / acromion region, upper right corner of the image

devices.type: Black rectangular redaction/label bar (image annotation, not on patient)
devices.location: Top right corner of the image, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Unfolded, tortuous thoracic aorta with a prominent aortic knob (age-related ectasia); no definite mediastinal mass
Mildly prominent central bronchovascular markings, likely age-related / chronic; no focal consolidation
Degenerative changes of the shoulders (acromioclavicular / glenohumeral joints) and mild diffuse osteopenia consistent with age

description_zh: 正面（疑似PA）胸部X光，吸氣深度足夠、無明顯旋轉，氣管居中。雙側肺野清晰，未見局部實質浸潤、結節或肋膜積液，雙側肋膈角銳利，橫膈輪廓平滑，右側橫膈略高於左側屬正常。心臟大小正常（心胸比約0.45），胸主動脈迂曲延長、主動脈弓突出，符合年齡相關變化；雙側肺門血管影略明顯但無腫塊。骨骼呈雙肩退化性變化及輕度骨質疏鬆，未見肋骨骨折；左肩區可見外在圓形金屬標記物，無胸管、中央靜脈導管或心律調節器等植入裝置。
